title: 1999 HMMT February Algebra Problem 4
statement: Find all possible values of \(\frac{d}{a}\) where \(a^{2}-6 a d+8 d^{2}=0, a \neq 0\).

solutions.text: Dividing \(a^{2}-6 a d+8 d^{2}=0\) by \(a^{2}\), we get \(1-6 \frac{d}{a}+8\left(\frac{d}{a}\right)^{2}=0\). The roots of this quadratic are \(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{4}\).
